headline: Cartier Tank Must vs Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso
stop_reason: Attempt 3 stopped before drafting. The JLC Reverso Classic pair is still about 60% above the Tank Must (roughly $6,200+ vs $3,750-$3,900 US), so SAME MONEY is not possible. A closer pair was checked: Baume & Mercier Clifton steel M0A10468 is $3,150 on Bucherer US (2026 page, undated day), about 19% under the large Tank Must strap at $3,900 (Luxury Bazaar, after the May 21, 2026 increase). That is outside the 10% band, and no same-day, same-source price pair was found. No clean, permitted product photo was found for either reference (library has no matches for WSTA0109 or Reverso). Next step: pick a pair with two same-day US list prices within 10% and clean permitted product shots, then rerun.
